title: Get Dev Board Play Running
description: Fix the worktree so `bun i` succeeds and the development board play target can run. Initial failure: `@semio/sketchpad@*`, `@semio/sketchpad@^0.1.0`, and `semio@file:../../client/lib/rs/pkg` fail to resolve during `bun install`. Scope: inspect and update existing package/Nx/script configuration for the board play path and related local workspace packages, then validate install and runtime as far as feasible.
summary: Aligned Nx packages to 21.6.11, kept the board package script as the Nx target entrypoint, and hardened board dev startup against JavaScript debug-terminal environment leakage by clearing inspector variables and disabling dynamic/native runner behavior for the board dev path. Verified @elements/board build, direct dev readiness under simulated inspector variables, wrapper dev readiness on port 6046, and HTTP 200 from the Vite server.
